title: QIDI Box with 3+ Boxes: 'Communication timeout during homing' on tool changes (QIDI_Q2 #33)
note: Installed by default (harmless without a Box: the changed branch is only taken for homing that involves a Box board). Home all (G28) checked on a printer without a Box on 20.11.2026 - the timeout itself is not tested (no Box). With 3 or more QIDI Boxes, a tool change can stop the print with 'Error during homing b_endstop: Communication timeout during homing' every few hundred changes (QIDI_Q2 #33, 01.01.02.x and 03.02). The Box hub sensors are on the Box board at the end of the USB chain, and homing across two boards allows only 50 ms (TRSYNC_TIMEOUT) for the boards to hear each other; the reporter fixed it with 250 ms. This module gives 250 ms (Klipper's single-board value) only to homing that involves a Box board (mcu_box*); Z homing with the nozzle sensor and all other homing keep 50 ms. Not tested here (no Box): based on the issue report. Restarts Klipper.
